{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Define success as status == 'completed'
# Filter for only email and paid_search channels
df_filtered = df[df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['status'].apply(lambda x: (x == 'completed').mean())

# Calculate the difference: email minus paid_search
effect = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print results
conversion_rates, effect"}
